headline: Gannon overtake Millersville as the conference's top scorers
dek: Gannon have won seven, drawn one and lost once, and the defeat was their opening match at home to Lake Erie. Their 30 goals are more than any other programme has scored, and Millersville, who led that count on Tuesday, have been passed.
displaced_by: Gannon's goals figure (30) has passed Millersville's (26), so the standing dek's 'more than every programme except Millersville' and its 24-goal figure are both false

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Gannon have scored more than California (Pa.) and West Chester together, and nine of their goals are Rafa Hyde's: the tallest bar in the chart leans on one forward more than any other does.

wire.line: Ten different players have scored for E. Stroudsburg, and Steven Arias has seven of their 22 goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's home match against District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Johnstown have conceded 27 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, and have won one match, drawn one and lost six.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Millersville have won eight, drawn one and lost two, and have conceded seven goals across the season while scoring 26.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jaden Howard has made 38 saves for West Chester and been beaten five times.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rafael Santos has four goals and seven assists from 26 shots for Seton Hill.

last_match.line: Gannon's first conference match away from home went the way of their home ones; California (Pa.) had won every conference match until this one.

next_match.line: No programme has conceded fewer goals than West Chester, and no programme has scored more than Gannon.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
